metric: median input plus output tokens per operational-interpretation case
floor: All300valid; calibrated two-pass blind judges; no observed per-case score regression on dev or prospective holdout; preserved essential intent in independent source-to-candidate review; all GitHub Actions green for exact merge head. No claim of improved live agent behavior; document is on-demand context.
scope: Condensation of existing docs/PHILOSOPHY.md; tests interpretation/comprehension and necessary concept preservation, not autonomous tool compliance.
stop: Reject any material lost principle or observed score regression; inconclusive if judge disagreements unresolved or token delta within baseline repeated spread.
hypothesis: Remove duplicated rules, historical model tables and repeated process prose; retain /do, distinctive knowledge, deterministic tools, autonomy within authorization, real checks and evidence. Reduces loaded context with no loss on independent operational interpretation cases.
